method: Built-in imagegen, identity-preserving extension from current single idle and special-final frame references; flattened RGBA masters. Whole-atlas layout-copy attempts were rejected before import. No interpolation or shifted duplicate pixels counted as poses.

prompt_set.extension64: Exactly8x8:16 coherent walk drawings,16 single-primary anticipation/release/follow-through drawings,event8,8jump anticipation/takeoff/rise/apex/fall/land/recover,8stair ascent,8stair descent,8dodge ending standing. East three-quarter, fixed root, consistent equipment and body volume, transparent gutters, upper-left lighting, detailed crisp pixel art. Engine owns jump arc; no stairs or floor painted. Single idle reference preserves exact established character identity.
prompt_set.powered40: Exactly8x5:8 powered idle,8 powered walk,8 primary with one event4,8 guard,8 coherent exit to base. Single last-special frame and base-idle references. Maintain physical equipment for complete form and exit; separate effects stay out of body sheets. Do not invent additional weapons or form mechanics.
prompt_set.iona_primary_repairs: Wide4x4 primary16 and4x2 powered primary8. Same continuous spear and two hand grips; spearhead points RIGHT in every pose, no overhead flourish or left-pointing preparation. One loaded thrust and return, all bodies and full weapon clear of neighbours. Events8/4.
prompt_set.pendle_reload8: 4x2 single existing six-chamber revolver opens/ejects, left hand loads, checks, closes and settles; same slung rifle, no duplicate revolver/cylinder, all mechanical anatomy retained.
prompt_set.brine_secondary8: 4x2 secondary reel: right hand holds same harpoon gun near body, left glove finds and turns integral brass reel, brace backward then settle. One connected breathing line and same airpack/helmet. Tether is separate engine entity. No gun-butt shove.

identity_constraints.iona: Same mature human lancer, dark violet braid, berry split coat, gold-brown spear and silver head; maintained storm-ready acting, no invented physical form gear.
identity_constraints.tam: Mature human ice monk, grey knot/wraps, maroon sash/beads; Glacier Form grows blue-white shells around same forearms/shins, palm fingers remain visible at contact; ice recedes on exit.
identity_constraints.brine: Same sealed copper helmet/blue faceport, cream/olive canvas, one airpack/breathing hose and harpoon with integral reel; maintained braced rig, no swimming or invented gear.
identity_constraints.pendle: Only robot, western hat/duster/scarf/brass limbs. Longshot holds same rifle in both hands, revolver holstered, no duplicate slung rifle while held; coherent re-sling exit.
identity_constraints.mirra: Human oasis diviner, ivory headwrap/tunic and turquoise shawl; maintained shaping gestures, no watery replacement body, seals/currents separate.

limitations: These are east-facing base plus powered-form studies, not directional turnarounds or final layered production masters.
Frame count and uniqueness do not establish artistic quality; contour/body-volume and equipment cleanup still require artist approval.
Iona long-spear frame canvas must remain wide enough to preserve96px body height without shrinking.
Pendle base primary frame8 has a baked muzzle flash; runtime must suppress a second muzzle flash for that clip.
Brine anchors require regeneration when any packed source/frame order or import registration changes.

Pendle reload staging is visible, but enlarged cylinder face has approximately seven/eight small chamber-like marks. Six-round capacity is enforced by runtime; do not claim six visibly counted rounds. Targeted built-in imagegen correction returned HTTP400 safety rejection (violence), so the accepted strip was not silently repainted or replaced. Artist cleanup remains.
